title: Petition of the Berkshire Gas Company, pursuant to G.L. Chapter 164, Section 14, for approval and authorization to issue and sell on a negotiated basis additional First Mortgage Bonds in the aggregate principal amount of up to $10,000,000, to be sold at par; for an exemption from the advertising and competitive bid requirements of G.L. Chapter 164, Section 15; and for such other action as may be deemed necessary or appropriate in connection with the foregoing.
